title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Russell Crowe to Star in Sci-Fi Thriller Bluefly
excerpt: The first-time pairing will headline a black-ops Congo thriller directed by Predators filmmaker Nimród Antal, shooting on Australia's Gold Coast later this year.
body:
• Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe will co-star in Bluefly, a sci-fi action thriller set in the Congo.
  • The film follows a grieving UN translator drawn into a black-ops mission to recover a downed aircraft that officially does not exist.
  • Hungarian-American director Nimród Antal, known for Predators, will helm the project from a script by David Frigerio, William Eubank, and Carlyle Eubank.
  • Production is set to begin on Australia's Gold Coast later this year, with Highland Film Group handling international sales.

Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Russell Crowe are teaming up for the first time in Bluefly, a sci-fi action thriller that will shoot on Australia's Gold Coast later this year, according to multiple industry reports.

The film is directed by Nimród Antal, the Hungarian-American filmmaker best known for directing Predators (2010) and the Metallica concert film Through the Never (2013). The screenplay is written by David Frigerio, William Eubank, and Carlyle Eubank.

Plot and Premise

Bluefly follows a grieving UN translator who is pulled into a covert black-ops mission deep in the Congo to recover a downed aircraft that is not supposed to exist. While specific character details for Chopra Jonas and Crowe have not been disclosed, the premise suggests a high-stakes thriller blending military action with science fiction elements.

Highland Film Group is handling international sales for the project. Arianne Fraser, CEO of Highland Film Group, praised the casting in a statement.

"We have a stellar cast led by Russell Crowe and Priyanka Chopra Jonas who will ignite the screen in this high-stakes, sci-fi thrill ride with layers."

— Arianne Fraser, CEO, Highland Film Group

A Busy Stretch for Chopra Jonas

Bluefly adds another major project to Chopra Jonas's increasingly packed slate. The 44-year-old actor-producer is simultaneously attached to SS Rajamouli's ambitious Indian epic Varanasi, co-starring Mahesh Babu, which is eyeing a 2027 release. Her first look as the character Mandakini was unveiled in July to widespread attention.

Earlier this year, Chopra Jonas starred in The Bluff, a pirate action-adventure on Amazon Prime Video produced by the Russo Brothers, where she played Ercell "Bloody Mary" Bodden. She was also nominated for a Critics Choice Super Award for her 2025 thriller The Bluff and has continued building her production company and brand ventures, which are valued at over ₹580 crore.

The Bluefly role marks a shift into harder science fiction territory — a genre she has not previously explored in her Hollywood career.

Crowe's Prolific Run Continues

For Crowe, 62, Bluefly is the latest in a string of recent projects that includes the crime thriller The Get Out alongside Luke Evans, Teresa Palmer, and Aaron Paul. The Oscar winner has been averaging multiple film roles per year, spanning action, horror (The Pope's Exorcist franchise), and drama.

The Gold Coast location is familiar ground for Crowe, who is based in Australia. The region has become a major hub for international film production, attracting projects from Marvel, DC, and other major studios through generous Australian tax incentives and world-class studio facilities.

What to Watch For

With Antal's track record in tension-driven genre filmmaking and two globally recognized leads, Bluefly is positioned as a mid-budget genre play with international appeal. No release date or distributor has been announced. Highland Film Group is expected to present the project to buyers at upcoming film markets.

For the Indian diaspora, the project reinforces Chopra Jonas's status as the most prominent Indian actor working consistently in Hollywood — now anchoring a film opposite one of the industry's most decorated stars.
